answer: The defence here is bone conduction audio signature proof: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. A farm running 479 aliases would need 479 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the walnut up to the light, weigh the velvet of the attack, and keep the meadow of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
